messages:
Alex: FYI — VendorFlux is asking to redistribute our quantized model weights via their cloud marketplace. They want co-marketing, a 20/80 revenue split (them/us), and a lightweight attribution banner. Thoughts? :eyes:
Rachel: Do we have precedent for a 20/80 split on open weights? IIRC we did 10/90 with smaller SI partners. Need SKU mapping + pricing floor.
Sanjeev: Important: we have to confirm license allows redistribution of quantized builds. Which variant are they asking for — 4-bit or int8? Quantized exports sometimes include downstream use restrictions.
Marta: Quick proposal: tiered split by support level
 - Marketplace-only distribution: 15/85
 - Marketplace + SI-managed deployment: 25/75 (they take ops and support)
Also require a standard attribution snippet: "Powered by Redwood Inference — model provided by VendorFlux (v1.2)."
Priya: For announcements — VendorFlux wants joint press in the same week as their region launch. We should push for a 2-week embargo so we can coordinate assets and short case study. Also need product tile in their SKU catalog (example: VF-REDWOOD-QUANT-v1).
Alex: @Rachel can you capture SKU naming convention and pricing floor? @Sanjeev please check license/compat. @Marta can you draft the attribution text as an HTML snippet we can hand off?
Rachel: Running numbers now. If we go 15/85, unit economics are fine if their marketplace fee <= 10%. If their fee is higher we need to renegotiate or raise our floor.
Sanjeev: Re license check: VendorFlux sent a permissive Apache-like header but included a second clause about "distribution of altered weights requires explicit consent." That will block straight redistribution of our quantized artifacts. Asking Legal.
LegalBot: Quick legal note:
- If downstream redistribution of derived weights is restricted, we must either (a) provide a redistribution grant in the MSA, or (b) deliver only an API-serveable artifact (no downloadable weights).
- Export control: confirm target regions (EU ok, APAC TBD).
- Attribution: require a short clause in the partner agreement and a sample attribution line for marketplace UI.
Priya: If we can't give downloadable weights, we can offer a hosted endpoint via Redwood Dedicated in their marketplace listing and co-bill. That preserves control and still enables their go-to-market.
Marta: Drafting two paths in parallel:
  Path A: Redistribution allowed — provide quantized bundle + 15/85 split + attribution + pricing floor.
  Path B: Redistribution restricted — provide hosted integration SKU (VF-REDWOOD-HOSTED) + 20/80 (higher due to infra) + joint marketing.
Alex: Sounds good. Next steps: Rachel to confirm marketplace fees and SKU naming by EOD tomorrow, Sanjeev to get license clarity from VendorFlux + ping Legal for a redistribution grant template, Marta to prepare attribution + two-path PR brief, Priya to book tentative announcement week and coordinate comms with VendorFlux PM.
Rachel: noted. pinging @VendorFlux-PM for fee breakdown.
Sanjeev: I'll request the original license file and a contact for legal transfer.
Marta: Will drop attribution HTML + two-slide PR brief in this thread when ready. :thumbsup:
LegalBot: I'll draft a short addendum template for redistribution and export checklist and upload into shared drive.
Alex: Thanks everyone — let's aim to finalize by end of week so we can lock the embargo.
Priya: +1, will hold the week in the calendar and loop in comms.
Alex: tagging next steps here: Rachel (fees/SKU), Sanjeev (license), Marta (assets/PR), Priya (announce window), LegalBot (addendum).
